examples.title: Recorded: specialize a universal hypothesis
examples.description: An actual mixed-retention model proof: eight commands found in 16 model calls, with nine proof nodes and independent native replay. The universal equality is a hypothesis. This is an exposed, deterministic template example, not newly discovered mathematics.

examples.title: Equality symmetry
examples.description: Given n = m, prove m = n. This short proof script is hand-written for the playground.
examples.theorem: forall n m. n = m -> m = n

examples.title: Add zero on the right
examples.description: Show that adding zero on the right leaves a natural number unchanged. This simplification script is hand-written.

examples.title: Choose an explicit witness
examples.description: Construct a natural number equal to n + 1. This witness-selection script is hand-written.
examples.theorem: forall n. exists m. m = n + 1

examples.title: Negative example: 0 = 1
examples.description: False in Peano arithmetic, with deliberately no proof script. A failed bounded search on an arbitrary input is not itself a disproof.
